# Crosswalk

> A mapping aid for engineers, architects and auditors. It records which controls have checked evidence in which repository and where there are gaps. It is not legal advice, not a conformity assessment and not a statement that any system complies with anything.

Controls from different frameworks that cite the same evidence file. This is derived from the mappings, not an official equivalence between the frameworks: two controls sharing a file means the same repository artefact supports both, not that they ask for the same thing.
